title: Introduction
lead: Skein UI is a React component library on [Base UI](https://base-ui.com): one component API, and the look of HeroUI, Ant Design, shadcn or your own brand by switching a theme style.

what.title: What it is
what.p1: More than 150 components: buttons and forms, overlays, navigation, data display, an admin layout, a data table with its toolbar, query builder and bulk actions, a message thread for support conversations, kanban, agenda, and a family of AI chat components. Behaviour and accessibility come from Base UI where it has the component; the rest are written to the same standard.
what.p2: Around the library there is a CLI that creates projects and pages, and a set of tools that let AI coding agents write correct Skein code: a machine-readable manifest of every component, `skein check`, `skein preview` and an MCP server.

split.title: Behaviour and looks, apart
split.p1: Components own behaviour and structure only; every visual lives in a theme style. The two meet in `data-*` attributes: a component writes `data-slot`, `data-variant`, `data-color`, `data-size` and its state, and the theme style's CSS styles those attributes.
split.ui: Behaviour, structure, accessibility, keyboard, the `data-*` attributes. No CSS.
split.themes: Every visual: tokens, light and dark, one CSS file per component, per theme style.
split.p2: So switching the theme style, the colour theme or dark mode only changes a few attributes on `<html>`: component code and behaviour stay exactly the same.

packages.title: Packages
packages.name: Package
packages.themes: Theme styles `default`, `shadcn`, `heroui`, `antd`, colour themes, density, code-block themes. Import only what you use.
packages.cli: The `skein` command: create projects, add pages, manage theme styles, docs and checks for agents.
packages.alias: `npx skeinui …`: the same commands under another name.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.style: **No `className` / `style` on components.** Looks come from props (`variant`, `color`, `size`) and the theme style. For a look of your own, adjust or write a theme style.
conventions.data: **Data-driven props.** Lists, menus, tables and forms take plain data (`items`, `columns`, `options`); `ReactNode` and `render` props are there when data isn't enough.
conventions.state: **The same state props everywhere.** Values are `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`; anything that opens is `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`.
conventions.overlay: **Overlays are one part.** `Dialog.Content`, `Popover.Content`, `Menu.Content`… wrap Base UI's portal, positioner and popup.
